about_the_game:
Build your team. Control the franchise. Become a legend.

Step into the locker room and take control of a professional football franchise in Ultimate Pro Football Coach, a deep, strategic simulation where every decision matters: Scout hidden gems, sign superstar free agents, hire staff, manage finances, and navigate the pressure of ownership and fans as you build your football dynasty.

Whether you’re rebuilding a bottom-tier team or chasing a three-peat, the future of your franchise is in your hands.

Ultimate Coach Simulation

  • Coach career progression, dynamic career milestones and coach upgrades.

  • Realistic player attributes, player styles, archetypes and traits.

  • Player mentality, team chemistry, and off-field events directly impact your season

  • In-depth coach, team and player stat tracking, career arcs, suspensions, and injuries

  • Yearly awards, All-Pro selections, and Hall of Fame tracking across careers

  • Follow league-wide news, standings, and player movement in the news hub

Immersive Franchise Mode

  • Draft, trade, and develop players through a dynamic career system

  • Negotiate contracts, manage salary cap, and balance your books

  • Hire coordinators and staff members who shape your team’s identity

  • Improve team performance with stadium and facility upgrades and training investments

  • Sign franchise sponsorship deals to increase income and athletic gear contracts to boost player abilities

  • Set seasonal goals with the franchise owner to earn income boosts for your on-field performance.

Intense Game Day Experience

  • Call Plays in Real Time: Take command with offensive play-calling during key drives, adjusting based on field position and game momentum

  • In-Game Adjustments: Adapt your strategy mid-game by switching your play tendencies, and game tempo

  • Opponent Scouting Reports: Use weekly reports to identify opponent strengths, key players, and opponent tendencies

  • Stamina Control: Dynamic player stamina impacts their rep count, forcing realistic rotation decisions and affecting performance late in games

Comprehensive Front Office Management

  • Flexible Cap Control: Navigate the complexities of multi-year contract structuring, cap rollover strategies and front/back-loaded deals,

  • Full Draft Day Experience: Navigate a live draft room with scouting insights, player projections, trade offers, and real-time team board

  • Comprehensive Training Systems: Develop both staff and players through structured regimens

  • Ring of Honor Integration: Hire legendary retired players as coaches or staff members

  • Awards and Hall of Fame Trackers: Monitor player award selections and celebrate long-term career achievements.

  • Robust Trade Engine: Balanced AI trading with value-based logic and negotiation options

  • Player/Coach/Staff Customization: Edit names, appearances, player numbers and outfits

  • Custom League Files: Community-built team files with custom names, logos, and designs to personalize your franchise experience.

Every Decision Matters

Set your own path as a legendary coach. 
Will you build a dynasty through elite scouting and drafting?
Dominate free agency with bold moves?
Or focus on long-term financial stability, staff growth, and internal development?

Choose your approach and build a culture that lasts generations.

Your franchise. Your rules. Your dynasty.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 12 or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1+ (Apple Silicon only)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Disk usage increases with length of save

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 1.8+ GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Must support OpenGL 2.1 or higher. Intel HD 3000 or better.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Disk usage increases with length of save
